description:
Title: Infrastructure automation engineer

Location: Remote

The Lead, Infrastructure automation engineer role is part of the Cloud and Compute engineering organisation to drive an improved developer experience and automation first approach for adoption of public and hybrid cloud computing environment in a secured manner. This role will be passionate about developing cloud-agnostic infrastructure provisioning and lifecycle management automation, ensuring associated security and compliance guardrails to meet application hosting requirements. The role is foran individual contributor who will develop Terraform, Chef and Python REST API based automation for automated provisioning, change, and decommission of VM, IaaS and PaaS database and Cloud resources in public cloud AWS, Azure, GCP and private cloud.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and enforce CIS security standards for Windows and Linux operating systems using Chef or similar configuration management tools.
  • Deliver new cloud services to the business, while simplifying and improving service consumption and operational management
  • Leverage Python REST APIs to develop “Zero” touch provisioning, patching, change and decommissioning of VM, Kubernetes, PaaS database for lifecycle management of Hybrid Cloud resources.
  • Develop REST APIs in python using BDD methodology and implement public cloud security guardrails.
  • Partner with Kenvue application teams for proof of technology in public cloud computing environment.
  • Build Hybrid Cloud infrastructure provisioning workflows leveraging continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines (CI / CD) running on Jenkins and or other CI CD tools.
  • Partner with Kenvue application teams and drive resolution of sophisticated technical problems across infrastructure and application stack.
  • Design, engineer, implement Infrastructure As Code with API first and microservices based approach for public cloud service.
  • Leverage internal and external resources to develop, advance and retain talent.
  • Review current processes and find opportunities for automation and build common frameworks in agile manner that cultivate adoption of automation across all layers.
  • Groom Jira features and stories to improve reliability and reduce support incidents for global infrastructure

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree required, preferably in STEM field.
  • 5 years of progressive experience in a combination of development, design in areas of cloud computing and infrastructure engineering.
  • Strong Infrastructure as a Code (IaC) experience on hybrid cloud environment,
  • Observability, through tools such as Prometheus, Elasticsearch, Grafana, DataDog or Zipkin is a plus.
  • 2+ years hands-on experience in Chef or similar config management tool is required
  • 2+ years hands-on experience in AWS, Azure, or GCP is required
  • Experience building Restful APIs is required.
  • 1+ year of Terraform experience.
  • Experience in Kubernetes is preferred
  • VMware experience is preferred.
  • Open-Source virtualization experience like KVM and Ovirt is preferred.
  • Understanding of GIT-based source code management, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery (CI / CD) practices using tools like Jenkins, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Groovy Scripting
  • Strong understanding of agile development processes and Agile tool set JIRA Python development experience is preferred but development experience with one or more of the following languages may be acceptable : Go, Scala, Java, Ruby, Python
  • Experience in supporting global operations and following enterprise level process frameworks. Good social, oral and written communication skills are preferred.
  • Self-starter with positive relationship abilities and customer service skills is preferred

title: B2B Growth Marketing Manager (Paid Media & HubSpot)
description:
Bluelight is a leading software consultancy dedicated to designing and developing innovative technology that enhances users' lives. With a steadfast commitment to delivering exceptional service to our clients, Bluelight excels in its focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Our mission is not only to create cutting‑edge applications but also to foster a collaborative and enriching work environment where each team member can grow and thrive. With a presence across the United States and Central/South America, Bluelight is in an exciting phase of expansion, continually seeking exceptional talent to join its dynamic and diverse community.

We are looking for a skilled individual to join our rapidly growing team at Bluelight. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment where everyone's opinions and efforts are valued and appreciated. You will have the opportunity to contribute to challenging and meaningful projects, developing high‑quality applications that stand out in the market. We value continuous learning, personal growth, and hard work, offering a collaborative environment that promotes professional development. If you are passionate about software development and eager to be part of a growing software consultancy, we invite you to apply and join us on this exciting journey.

About the Role

  • We are looking for a growth‑focused B2B marketer with a strong foundation in paid media and marketing automation. You will be responsible for driving qualified leads to our nearshore staffing solutions using a mix of paid strategies and sophisticated HubSpot automation.
  • You will not just be "buying media", you will be owning the engine that connects innovative US companies with world‑class engineering talent in Latin America. You are well‑versed in Google Campaign Manager, LinkedIn Ads, and HubSpot, and you understand the nuances of marketing complex B2B services to technical decision‑makers.
  • Our ideal candidate thrives on data and uses it to craft high‑performing B2B campaigns. You understand that selling a partnership is different from selling a product, it requires trust, authority, and multiple touch points. You are organized, detail‑oriented, and possess a "White Belt Mentality", always eager to learn and improve. Above all, you are a "Human" first, bringing a positive, engaged personality that strengthens our remote, transparency‑first culture.

Key Responsibilities

  • B2B Media Planning & Strategy:
  • HubSpot Ownership: Serve as the internal subject matter expert for HubSpot. You will not just use it, but optimize it—building workflows, lead scoring models, and attribution reports that connect ad spend to closed client deals.
  • Strategic Planning: Develop comprehensive B2B media plans that target decision‑makers at startups and enterprise companies who need to scale their engineering teams.
  • Market Research: Conduct deep analysis to identify where our target audience (technical leaders) consumes content and how best to reach them.
  • Innovation: Stay abreast of emerging B2B trends, AI integrations in marketing, and new channels for reaching technical talent buyers.
  • Sales Enablement: Advise the New Business and Account teams on recommended budgets and strategies to support their pipeline goals.
  • Campaign Execution & Management:
  • Multi‑Channel Execution: Oversee the execution of paid media campaigns with a heavy focus on LinkedIn Ads (Account‑Based Marketing) and Google Ads (High‑intent search).
  • Vendor Management: Manage relationships with external vendors or agencies to ensure day‑to‑day execution aligns with our strategic vision.
  • Full‑Funnel Analytics: Track B2B KPIs beyond just "clicks"—focusing on MQLs (Marketing Qualified Leads), SQLs (Sales Qualified Leads), Cost Per Discovery Call, and Pipeline Velocity.
  • Optimization: Analyze campaign data to identify areas for improvement, such as refining audience segments (e.g., targeting specific tech stacks like React or Python users) to improve lead quality.
  • Budget & ROI Management:
  • Budget Pacing: Manage and allocate media budgets effectively across channels to maximize Client Acquisition Cost (CAC) efficiency.
  • Forecasting: Maintain daily, weekly, and monthly budget pacing, ensuring campaigns remain on schedule and within financial targets.
  • Efficiency: Identify opportunities for cost‑saving without compromising the quality of inbound leads.

Skills & Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in B2B performance marketing or media buying. Experience specifically in the Staffing, Recruiting, or SaaS sectors is a massive plus.
  • HubSpot Proficiency is Required: Must have deep experience with HubSpot Marketing Hub (workflows, landing pages, list segmentation) and CRM integration. HubSpot certifications are highly preferred.
  • Paid Media Expert: Strong experience in paid platforms, specifically LinkedIn Campaign Manager (for B2B targeting) and Google Ads.
  • Analytical Mindset: Proficiency in analytics and attribution tools (Google Analytics 4, HubSpot Reports, LinkedIn Insights Tag).
  • Strong Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to explain complex marketing data to non‑marketing stakeholders.
  • Self‑Motivated: Able to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining close collaboration with the team.

Company Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance‑based salary increases.
  • Generous paid‑time‑off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company‑sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

Being a consultant in our team is a fun, challenging, and rewarding career choice. Your contributions are highly valued by clients, and the work you do often has a direct and significant impact on their business.

You will have the opportunity to work on a variety of projects for our incredible clients, which will accelerate your career growth. You’ll collaborate with modern technologies and work alongside some of the best professionals in the industry!

Suporte ao Planejamento : Colaborar com o planejamento orçamentário, fornecendo dados históricos e projeções.

Compliance e Processos : Assegurar a conformidade das operações financeiras com as políticas internas e a legislação vigente. Propor melhorias nos processos financeiros para aumentar a eficiência e controle.

Colaborar com outras áreas da clínica (faturamento, administrativo) para garantir a integridade dos dados financeiros.

Qualificações Necessárias :

Formação superior completa em Ciências Contábeis, Administração de Empresas, Economia ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência comprovada como Analista Financeiro, preferencialmente no setor de saúde (clínicas, hospitais, laboratórios) ou em empresas que exigem alta acurácia e processos estruturados.

Sólidos conhecimentos em princípios contábeis, gestão de contas a pagar e receber, conciliação e análise de resultados.

Domínio avançado do Pacote Office, com excelência em Excel (tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas complexas, dashboards).

Familiaridade com sistemas ERP ou softwares de gestão financeira.

Habilidades e Competências :

  • Organização, proatividade e autonomia para gerenciar tarefas e prazos.

Company Overview

Our client is a profitable SaaS company that has supported property managers for over a decade. With more than 20,000 active users and 100M+ inspection photos processed, the platform helps customers—from single landlords to large firms—save time and reduce stress with mobile inspections, automated reports, and AI-powered tools. The team of ~20 people is fully distributed and focused on steady growth and long-term value.

Your Role

You’ll help us show how zInspector fits into real property-management work. Most of what you make will be short videos, screen walkthroughs, carousels, and posts for social channels (Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts) plus some email content.

You’ll work with our Marketing Director and use inputs like support questions, product updates, and common scenarios to explain when a feature is useful and what changes for a property manager when they use it.

You’ll :

  • Produce short videos, screen recordings, carousels, and posts that show when a feature matters and why
  • Use inputs from support, product notes, and example scenarios to create concrete explanations
  • Adapt one idea into multiple formats across social, YouTube Shorts, and email
  • Write short, clear captions and copy that link a specific problem to how zInspector helps

Keep visual style and language consistent across channels

Look at basic stats (views, watch time, clicks, comments) and share what seems worth repeating

Add finished assets to our internal library so other teams can reuse them

You Bring

  • You write in clear, simple language and get to the point
  • You’ve made short-form content before (social posts and / or simple videos—class projects are fine)
  • You’re comfortable recording your screen and doing basic edits (cuts, captions, trimming)
  • You can follow a content plan and ship work on a steady weekly rhythm
  • You’re curious about how property managers actually work and what slows them down
  • You’re organized and follow through on what you commit to
  • You can work a schedule that overlaps with our core hours

Bonus Points :

  • You’ve made how-to or tutorial-style content before
  • You’ve been around property management, real estate, or operations in any capacity
  • You’ve written short marketing-style copy or email-like content
  • You’ve used Canva or Figma (or are fine learning quickly)
  • You’ve had any exposure to SaaS or workflow tools

What’s Offered :

  • Part-time or full-time hours, depending on your current schedule
  • Mostly remote work, with optional time in our Davis office if you’re local
  • Hourly pay based on experience and availability
  • Direct work with the Marketing Director on real product content
  • A role focused on one product and one audience, not a mix of unrelated projects

Interview Process :

Online tests – short assessment and typing test

  1. Screening call
  2. Marketing challenge – one short social / video post plus a simple written version
  3. Interview with the Marketing Director
  4. Final interview with the CEO

Most candidates move through the process in about 1–2 weeks .

Job Description : Overview

The App Support LOS Administrator II provides mid-level end-user support for the Encompass LOS and integrated Consumer Direct platforms. This role works alongside existing Scrum Teams and enhancement-focused Encompass Administrator groups but is primarily focused on end-user experience, ticket triage, and break-fix remediation using a Kanban workflow. The App Support LOS Administrator II manages moderate-complexity issues, resolves Tier 2 tickets, supports the break-fix / maintenance channel, and contributes to release readiness and documentation. This role also mentors App Support LOS Administrator I and helps maintain platform stability and user satisfaction.

Responsibilities

End-User Support & Ticket Resolution

  • Troubleshoot user access issues, workflow errors, data-entry problems, and general LOS usage questions.

Break-Fix / Kanban Support Workflow

  • Support the Kanban-based break-fix and maintenance process for resolving issues outside standard release cycles.

User Access & System Readiness

  • Support user onboarding / offboarding, permissions updates, and profile troubleshooting.

Testing & Release Support

Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Work with Scrum Teams and enhancement-focused Administrators to align break-fix work with sprint activity.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, Engineering, and Support teams as needed.
  • Mentor App Support LOS Administrator I on troubleshooting and support practices.
  • Maintain SOPs, KB articles, and documentation.

Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of Encompass support or LOS Help Desk experience.

  • Experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow or Jira.

title: Financial Planning Analyst
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

What is this role?

Strong financial analysis and forecasting enables Teachable to determine how best to deploy our resources to continue (and accelerate) our growth. We’re looking for an FP&A analyst with a strong sense of ownership who can assess the opportunities ahead of us and help Teachable make sound business decisions. This position reports to the FP&A Manager and will be heavily involved in various finance needs of the company, with an emphasis on financial reporting, forecasting, cross-department partnerships, and data integrity.

You will have full visibility of Teachable’s P&L focused on labour spend, and build reports to monitor our labour financial performance and help identify opportunities. You will be responsible for deeply understanding and managing the labour model, labour KPIs, unit economics and forecasting models.

If you enjoy the challenge of transforming business questions into financial models and are passionate about the creator economy, we want you on our Finance team at Teachable!

What You’ll Do :

  • Own Teachable Monthly Labour process, including updating actuals and forecasts;
  • Support the buildup of labour-related Balance Sheet accounts and Cash Flow statements and own the monthly updates and analyses.
  • Collaborate with HR and various teams on workforce planning, analyzing financial data, and develop actionable insights.
  • Own labour reporting package consolidated by our FP&A team and sent to our parent company, Hotmart, on a monthly basis.
  • Be the focal point for all labour cost data and partner closely with HR team to develop reports and dashboards for financial and other business needs.
  • Provide continuous improvements on tools and analysis methodologies, elevating visibility to key stakeholders.

Requirements :

  • Bachelor’s degree in relevant fields (Business, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Accounting)
  • 3+ years of experience in FP&A, Business Operations or HR Finance Business Partner
  • Strong modeling (Excel) skills
  • Ability to handle multiple projects and to analyze a big volume of data and support on reporting results to senior leadership
  • Strategic data analysis, BI tooling, SQL and database experience (Sigma) a plus
  • Excited to work independently and chart your own course, while knowing when to seek guidance

While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

title: Lead Wordpress Developer
description:
About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.

Because this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!

The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.

You’ll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You’ll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.

Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A / B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data

HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy

Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges

Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed

Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI / CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF, Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript / jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles

Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members

Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A / B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

Conhecimento em Kubernetes, com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm / Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.

Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD, incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.

Experiência com GitLab, aplicando CI / CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.

Conhecimento aprofundado em OCI (Oracle Cloud) e GCP (desejável), incluindo arquitetura, IAM, redes, automações e boas práticas de segurança.

Conhecimento em Terraform, incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.

Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog (desejável), New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.

Experiência com scripting e automação, utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.

Vivência prática com CI / CD, desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue / green).

Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers, incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.

  • Maintain and enhance the ETL, web and API systems.
  • Ensure the systems are highly available, scalable, and performant.
  • Work with Amazon AWS services to deploy, monitor, and manage the systems.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues in the production environment.
  • Optimize the performance of the systems and ensure they meet security standards.
  • Document the design, implementation, and operation of the systems.
  • Architect and maintain front end web applications.

Technical Skills

  • Experience maintaining and developing new features in Ruby on Rails web applications, particularly those used for software and model simulation management.
  • Experience in backend development with a modern programming language such as Python.
  • Proven experience with ETL systems and API microservices development.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture.
  • Experience with CI / CD pipelines and automated testing.
  • Experience building and deploying high-quality front‑end web applications in Angular / Vue, React.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with video streaming services.
  • Familiarity with container orchestration tools like Kubernetes.
  • Deep understanding of microservices architecture.
  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools.
  • Familiarity with Java SpringBoot.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Redis, MongoDB, Docker, and Websockets.

Required Education

Bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.

Language

Advanced English. Direct interface with global teams. Reporting to a Manager in the US.

Soft Skills

  • Compatibility with Our Values in Action (Caterpillar Code of Conduct)
  • Autonomy: Being able to manage yourself, deal with a large number of tasks and solve minor problems proactively and responsibly.
  • Communication: Can clearly express ideas, thoughts and concepts in order to influence others or gain support.
  • Problem Solving: Able to carefully analyze situations, understand the details and root causes of problems, and resolve them independently and effectively.
  • Attention to Detail: Capable of thoroughly reviewing and interpreting facts, plans, or projects, contributing to quality assurance and impact analysis.

The Senior Benefits Manager – Latin America will lead the strategy, design, and management of employee benefits programs across the Latin American region for a global technology company. This role ensures our benefits offerings are competitive, scalable, compliant, and aligned with our mission to attract and retain world-class talent. You’ll serve as a trusted regional expert—partnering closely with Global Rewards, regional and local HR, Finance, Legal, Operations—to create an exceptional employee experience that reflects our culture of innovation, agility, and wellbeing.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive benefits strategy that supports the company’s growth and employee value proposition across Latin America.
  • Act as the regional thought leader on benefits trends, market practices, and digital innovations in the Global Rewards space.
  • Collaborate with Global Rewards and HR leadership to ensure benefits design aligns with global benefits strategy and vision.
  • Consult and guide the benefits team members as well as our brokers on the strategy and objectives for the benefits function overall.

Program Design & Management

  • Design and manage benefits programs—health, retirement, life, disability, and wellbeing—across multiple Latin American markets (e.g., Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Argentina, Chile, Peru).
  • Drive scalability and efficiency through regional harmonization, technology enablement, and vendor consolidation where appropriate.
  • Lead annual renewals, plan design changes, and benchmarking in partnership with global brokers and local consultants.
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and performance metrics to ensure best-in-class service delivery.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with local regulations, labor laws, and reporting requirements.
  • Collaborate with Legal, Payroll, and Finance to maintain robust governance and operational accuracy.
  • Monitor legislative developments and assess their impact on program design and cost.

Employee Experience & Engagement

  • Develop compelling communication strategies that help employees understand and value their benefits.
  • Partner with internal communications, HR, and local teams to integrate benefits into broader employee experience and wellbeing initiatives.
  • Champion wellbeing, inclusivity, and flexibility in benefits programs to meet the diverse needs of our workforce.

Analytics & Continuous Improvement

  • Leverage data and market insights to drive benefits strategy and cost management decisions.
  • Track and report key metrics related to participation, utilization, and employee satisfaction.
  • Identify opportunities for process automation and digital transformation to enhance efficiency and employee experience.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience with a leadership position managing employee benefits in a multi-country regional role across Latin America.
  • Proven success in benefits management within a highly matrixed, high-growth technology or multinational environment.
  • Deep understanding of regional benefits practices, legislation, and market dynamics.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects in a fast-paced, matrixed organization.
  • Strong teamwork, analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.

Preferred Skills & Attributes

  • Passion for innovation, technology, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience with HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors).
  • Skilled at balancing strategic vision with hands‑on execution.
  • Culturally fluent and adept at influencing across diverse teams.
  • Commitment to creating inclusive, employee‑centered benefits programs.

Fundada em 1996, a Petrobahia foi uma das primeiras distribuidoras regionais a entrar em operação no país, se tornando sinônimo de empreendedorismo na nova fase que se iniciou no setor de combustíveis. Nessa época, os fundadores da empresa já atuavam na área - com uma rede de postos e uma das mais conceituadas transportadoras do mercado - e decidiram que era hora de uma nova e desafiadora empreitada : formar uma distribuidora de combustível regional com características muito específicas. A ideia, que logo se concretizou, foi atuar junto a pequenas cidades, que não possuíam postos, e em locais não assistidos pelas distribuidoras multinacionais, atendendo de perto às necessidades de cada cliente.

Todo o trabalho foi desenvolvido com muito planejamento e seriedade, logo tornando a Petrobahia reconhecida por duas importantes características : a solidez e a credibilidade. Hoje, a empresa continua aberta à inovação e atenta às oportunidades de mercado, contando com números expressivos : são 06 bases de operações e uma rede com cerca de 70 postos revendedores espalhados entre Bahia, Sergipe, Minas Gerais, Piauí e Pernambuco. Além disso, a companhia ainda possui cerca de 1000 clientes ativos, distribuídos entre grandes consumidores e postos bandeira branca. São resultados diretamente ligados ao trabalho de uma equipe amplamente preparada e à manutenção de uma relação forte e fidelizada com nossos clientes. Uma história de sucesso escrita a cada dia e movida a cada novo desafio.

Nossa estrutura

Nossos terminais estão entre os mais tecnológicos do País e atendem aos mais rigorosos estandartes de qualidade de todas as regiões onde atuamos e onde nossas bases estão distribuídas : Nordeste, Centro-Oeste, Norte e Sudeste.

Possuímos estrutura para cessão de espaço a congênere e uma Central de Relacionamento criada para melhor atender o cliente, com integração de todos os setores da Companhia e rápida capacidade de retorno.

Possuímos unidades em várias macrorregiões baianas e em outros estados, o que nos permite atender cidades espalhadas por diferentes polos e regiões.

title: Lead Wordpress Developer
description:
About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.

Because this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!

The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.

You’ll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You’ll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.

Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A / B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data

HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy

Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges

Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed

Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI / CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF, Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript / jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles

Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members

Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A / B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments

What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning

Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.

Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

Aqui a gente conecta o mundo.

A Sensedia é líder no mercado de APIs, oferecendo soluções de integração e consultoria a grandes empresas no Brasil e no mundo, em uma variedade de setores. Seu portfólio, além de uma plataforma API Management, inclui Sensedia Integrations, Service Mesh, API Adaptive Governance, Events Hub, Open Banking & Finance e equipes estratégicas de Professional Services.

Trabalhar aqui é pertencer a uma cultura plural, descontraída e inovadora. É para quem tem coragem de ir além, pensar e agir fora da caixa. Preferimos pedir desculpas ao invés de pedir permissão e estamos sempre dispostos a nos transformar, nos reinventar.

Nossas pessoas são incríveis e você pode fazer parte disso tudo. Nos comprometemos em garantir um ambiente de trabalho acolhedor e respeitoso.

Qual a missão do Cargo?

Como Analista de Suporte, sua missão é contribuir para a criação de uma experiência fluida, produtiva e agradável para os parceiros que utilizam nossas ferramentas, plataformas ou APIs e o ecossistema Open. O grande desafio deste cargo está em entender profundamente as necessidades técnicas e comportamentais de nossos clientes, identificar pontos de fricção e colaborar com times de produto, engenharia e suporte para propor melhorias contínuas.

Quais serão suas atividades do dia-a-dia?

  • Realizar a triagem, classificação e acionamento assertivos dos alertas identificados;
  • Realizar a análise de design de APIs e auxiliar os usuários em soluções de negócios e configurações;
  • Construir e analisar códigos Java / JavaScript;
  • Desenvolver dashboards de negócios;
  • Esclarecer dúvidas sobre as funcionalidades do produto;
  • Testar fluxos de APIs em produção;
  • Debugar o código;
  • Desenvolver conteúdos técnicos / processos;
  • Desenvolver automações para procedimentos internos com a plataforma;
  • Evangelizar o uso da plataforma para o cliente / Sensedia;
  • Garantir a boa experiência do usuário em relação a Sensedia (atendimento);
  • Integração com várias áreas da empresa como consultoria, engenharia e customer success;
  • Trabalho em equipe com o time de infraestrutura para ganhar agilidade no atendimento do ticket;
  • Ser parceiro dos nossos clientes;
  • Atender chamados, responder perguntas em canais de comunicação (como e-mail, chats ou fóruns) e acompanhar o atendimento até a resolução completa;
  • Apoiar a criação e atualização de conteúdos técnicos, como FAQs, tutoriais e guias de integração, com base nas principais dúvidas e dificuldades dos usuários.

Quais são os requisitos obrigatórios para esse cargo?

  • Conhecimento sobre support ao ecossistema Open;
  • Experiência com alguma linguagem de programação e scripts (ex. Java, JavaScript, python, go);
  • Excelente capacidade de análise e troubleshooting a sistemas críticos;
  • Conhecimento dos conceitos e práticas sobre APIs utilizando padrões de design RestFul (Experiência com integrações entre sistemas é um bom começo);
  • Capacidade de gerir ferramentas e interpretar dados de entrada / saída para diagnóstico de comportamento de sistemas, como forma de identificar problemas (Prometheus, Kibana, Grafana, Zabbix, etc.);
  • Conhecimento de Ferramentas de Testes Funcionais de APIs (Postman, cURL e SoapUI);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gerenciamento de tickets (Zendesk, Jira, etc);
  • Comunicação clara e assertiva.

Quais serão os requisitos diferenciais para este cargo?

  • Experiência prévia com suporte técnico voltado para desenvolvedores ou produtos com APIs.
  • Espanhol|Inglês técnico (leitura e escrita), suficiente para compreender documentações e comunicar-se com desenvolvedores de fora do Brasil.
  • Capacidade de produzir conteúdo técnico (artigos, tutoriais, exemplos de uso) de forma estruturada e didática.
  • Conhecimento em webservices SOAP;
  • Conhecimentos sobre documentação de APIs utilizando OpenAPI Specification (Swagger) e fluxos de negócio;

Sobre a Rodobens:

Com mais de 70 anos no mercado, a Rodobens é um dos maiores grupos financeiros do Brasil e tem ajudado milhares de pessoas a tirarem seus planos do papel e realizarem seus sonhos, independentemente do tamanho deles.

Contando com serviços de: consórcio, empréstimo, concessionárias próprias, financiamentos, seguros, telemedicina, e-commerce pra peças de automóveis, locação de veículos pessoais e de veículos comerciais, a Rodobens tem cada vez mais colocado clientes como o centro de seus valores e prezado pela inovação e praticidade.

Por que a Rodobens?

Narrando uma história de conquistas desde 1949, a Rodobens está sediada em São José do Rio Preto, mas possui uma unidade de negócio em São Paulo e diversas concessionárias espalhadas por todo o Brasil.

Aqui na Rodobens nós incentivamos que cada pessoa seja ela mesma. Acreditamos que diferentes visões e vivências são essenciais para o desenvolvimento da empresa e para a construção de um ambiente acolhedor.

A Rodobens respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Somos a maior rede de distribuição de veículos comerciais e peças genuínas Mercedes-Benz do país, com 27 pontos de venda presentes em 13 estados, tendoem seu portfólio caminhões, ônibus e utilitários.

Somos um dos principais grupos de moda do país, com cerca de 60 lojas em todo Brasil e mais de 30 anos de história. O grupo é composto pela SACADA, OH BOY e pela linha teen da marca, a YOBOH.

SACADA

São 27 lojas e mais de 500 multimarcas levando à todo Brasil o mood sofisticado e elegante que marcam a trajetória da SACADA. A cada coleção o universo da moda, arte e comportamento dão vida à novos conceitos que traduzem o desejo da mulher contemporânea, aliados ao cuidado na escolha dos materiais para criar peças versáteis e únicas. Elegância e modernidade formam a essência da mulher SACADA, que busca sofisticação e praticidade para as ocasiões do dia a dia. Especialmente para ela, os itens clássicos e indispensáveis do armário feminino são reinventados, criando coleções que se adaptam perfeitamente ao seu estilo de vida.

OH, BOY!

Com 24 lojas próprias e presente em mais de 800 multimarcas, a OH, BOY! é uma marca carioca de coração, que possui essência descontraída, urbana e jovem. Esta leveza se traduz em coleções confortáveis, femininas e descontraídas que misturam influências e estilos refletindo nossa personalidade plural. Temos um olhar moderno e único, cuja essência é inspirada pela luz do dia e o calor do sol. Desde o surgimento da marca o jeans é destaque nas coleções com suas modelagens incríveis, qualidade de materiais e atenção aos detalhes.

YOBOH

A YOBOH é a linha teen na OH BOY e está presente em lojas selecionadas da marca, além do ambiente online. Criamos produtos com qualidade e conforto para meninas entre 10 e 16 anos. As coleções são idealizadas para atender a este público de consumidores da geração Z, que buscam expressar sua personalidade através de seus looks e valorizam um consumo de qualidade.

você é uma pessoa que ama se conectar com gente e entender a história de cada cliente? aqui na FARM Rio, estamos à procura de quem se identifica com esses valores para fazer parte do nosso time de caixa . buscamos pessoas que se desafiam a criar experiências incríveis em cada atendimento e a colocar o talento em campo para alcançar os melhores resultados, sempre buscando surpreender e encantar em cada detalhe, fazendo viva a nossa cultura: ser gente boa, bom de gente e bom de jogo .

quer fazer parte de um time apaixonado por moda e por gente? vem pra FARM!

  • atender clientes com gentileza e encantamento;
  • finalizar as vendas utilizando o sistema LINX, garantindo uma experiência positiva ao cliente;
  • prestar atendimento online nos canais digitais;
  • responsável por abrir e fechar o caixa, conferindo todas as transações e garantindo que os valores em dinheiro, cartões e outros pagamentos estejam corretos, seguindo os procedimentos financeiros da empresa;
  • gerir, de forma eficiente, o processo de conferência, recebimento e envio de mercadorias;
  • oferecer suporte à gerência em diversas atividades;
  • colaborar para que a loja permaneça atrativa, organizada e encantadora para os clientes;
  • ser responsável pelas atividades administrativas da loja, incluindo:
  • gestão das solicitações de insumos;
  • gerenciamento de contas a pagar;
  • operação de processos de omnichannel;
  • participação em inventários;
  • garantia de pleno funcionamento de processos e equipamentos da loja;
  • trabalhar bem em equipe, com espírito colaborativo e inclusivo;
  • facilidade de comunicação, com gentileza na oratória e "escutatória";
  • interesse por moda, tendências, boas conversas e paixão pelo que faz;
  • ser uma pessoa dinâmica, flexível, ágil de se adaptar e organizada;
  • ter visão estratégica para entregar resultados e soluções de problemas;
  • domínio de ferramentas digitais e redes sociais;
  • conhecimento básico do pacote office;
  • desejável experiência anterior na função e no sistema Linx;
  • ensino médio completo;
  • flexibilidade de horário.

quem faz parte do time comercial FARM tem direito à:

  • para garantir o seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida:wellz (plataforma de saúde mental e bem estar)
  • assistência médica e odontológica com coparticipação;
  • política parental estendida: 180 dias para mães, 20 dias para pais
  • wellhub (Antigo Gympass)
  • day off, para curtir o seu aniversário;
  • e a melhor parte: descontos em roupas e acessórios da FARM e demais marcas do grupo Azzas.

Nasceu no Rio, cresceu no Brasil e se espalhou pelo mundo

a nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. o que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.

em 2019, cruzamos fronteiras e levamos o estilo de vida da FARM Rio para o mundo. de Nova York a Los Angeles, de Paris a Londres, nossas cores, estampas e essência seguem inspirando pessoas pelos quatro cantos do planeta. e seguimos sonhando, criando e levando o Brasil no coração para cada lugar que nos recebe.

title: Auxiliar Financeiro
description:
Descrição do Cargo : Auxiliar Financeiro

Resumo do Cargo : O Auxiliar Financeiro desempenha um papel fundamental no apoio às atividades financeiras da empresa.

Este profissional é responsável por auxiliar na gestão de contas a pagar e a receber, no controle de fluxo de caixa, na conciliação bancária e em outras tarefas relacionadas à área financeira.

Além disso, o Auxiliar Financeiro pode colaborar com a preparação de relatórios financeiros, auxiliar no processo de auditoria e fornecer suporte administrativo geral ao departamento financeiro.

Responsabilidades :

  • Auxiliar no processo de contas a pagar, incluindo o registro de despesas, verificação de faturas, lançamento de pagamentos no sistema e preparação de cheques ou pagamentos eletrônicos.
  • Apoiar as atividades de contas a receber, incluindo a emissão de faturas, o acompanhamento de recebimentos, a conciliação de contas e a emissão de relatórios de cobrança.
  • Realizar conciliações bancárias periódicas para garantir a precisão dos registros financeiros.
  • Manter registros atualizados de transações financeiras e garantir a organização e arquivamento adequados de documentos financeiros.
  • Auxiliar na preparação de relatórios financeiros periódicos, como demonstrativos de resultados, balanços patrimoniais e análises de variação.
  • Colaborar com auditorias internas e externas, fornecendo documentação e suporte necessários durante o processo.
  • Apoiar na gestão do fluxo de caixa, monitorando saldos bancários, prevendo necessidades de caixa e recomendando ações corretivas quando necessário.
  • Auxiliar na identificação e implementação de melhorias nos processos financeiros e administrativos, visando aumentar a eficiência e a precisão.
  • Fornecer suporte administrativo geral ao departamento financeiro, incluindo o atendimento de telefone, o gerenciamento de correspondências e o suporte na organização de eventos e reuniões.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre regulamentações financeiras e procedimentos internos da empresa, garantindo conformidade com as políticas estabelecidas.

Requisitos :

  • Ensino médio completo; preferencialmente graduação em Administração, Ciências Contábeis ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência prévia em funções administrativas ou financeiras.
  • Conhecimento básico de princípios contábeis e financeiros.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar com sistemas de gestão financeira e pacote Office.
  • Capacidade de realizar múltiplas tarefas e de trabalhar sob pressão.
  • Excelentes habilidades organizacionais e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente e em equipe.

Job description

A contratação poderá servir para fins de pós-doutoramento, caso a pessoa selecionada seja tenha o grau de Doutorado

O(a) candidato(a) estará sediado(a) e irá compor uma equipe de pesquisa sobre serviços de saúde com sede no Centro de Integração de Dados e Conhecimentos para Saúde (CIDACS/FIOCRUZ-BA), Salvador, Bahia, Brasil.

O projeto é financiado pela Gates Foundation.

Encorajamos fortemente candidaturas de pesquisadores negro(a)s, LGBTQIA+, pessoas com deficiência e de outros grupos menos representados.

Sobre a Rede Estadual de Dados em Saúde da Bahia (REDS):

Em 2021, foi criada a Rede Estadual de Dados em Saúde da Bahia (REDS), cujo propósito é integrar e unificar os dados de pacientes provenientes da rede estadual de saúde em um único repositório centralizado.

A REDS tem como foco a consolidação de prontuários eletrônicos, possibilitando, entre outros benefícios, a mensuração do cuidado e dos custos em nível individual do paciente, por meio de uma plataforma segura e atualizada em tempo real.

Considerando a ampla adoção do prontuário eletrônico na atenção primária, a REDS está em processo de expansão, impulsionada pela implementação do mesmo sistema de prontuário eletrônico utilizado em hospitais estaduais (o AGHUse).

Essa padronização é considerada estratégica e essencial para permitir a integração de dados com fins de coordenação do cuidado entre os diferentes níveis da rede de atenção à saúde.

A principal funcionalidade da REDS é viabilizar o acesso ao prontuário do paciente entre diferentes pontos da rede, consolidando dados de imunização, exames laboratoriais e registros clínicos, além de subsidiar análises de gestão orientadas à vigilância em saúde, ao monitoramento de políticas públicas e à tomada de decisão.

Main responsibilities

  • Articular a temática de redes interoperáveis, avaliação de impacto em serviços de saúde e análise de implementação de políticas e intervenções digitais na saúde entre os distintos grupos do projeto REDS
  • Auxiliar na gestão de equipe de pesquisadores de avaliação de impacto e epidemiologia
  • Produzir e aplicar um modelo metodológico de documentação e avaliação da REDS e sua integração com sistemas existentes, baseado em revisão de marcos conceituais sobre redes de interoperabilidade de dados em saúde e na sua proposta de valor para acesso e qualidade de serviços de saúde
  • Gerir a coleta, organização e análise dos dados de pesquisa qualitativa junto a participantes e demais pesquisadores
  • Documentar, sistematizar e apresentar aprendizados, ferramentas e recomendações para institucionalização dos achados do projeto.
  • Conduzir o planejamento e gerenciar o fluxo de entregas da pesquisa junto ao financiador internacional

Job Category

  • Realizar a abertura de OS (Ordens de Serviço) caso identifique necessidade de manutenção em algum equipamento da produção, evitando prejuízos produtivos à empresa;
  • Executar as atividades cumprindo as normas de segurança da empresa e as especificações de qualidade, bem como realizar vistoria desses itens através de Check List, visando seguir e manter o padrão estabelecido pela Bridgestone;

  • Fazer segregação de lote, utilizando o sistema BOSS, em casos de desvios de qualidade;
  • Cobrir férias dos Líderes do processo que trabalha;
  • Participar da implementação e coordenação da metodologia TPM (Manutenção Preventiva Total) na área em que trabalha, fazendo cumprir.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experiência Mínima: 2 anos na área industrial;
  • Formação: Ensino Médio Completo; Ensino Superior (Completo ou cursando) - Desejável;
  • Outros Cursos/Conhecimentos específicos: Bons conhecimentos de informática; Curso de operador de veículos industriais, com CNH para operador de veículos industriais; Atenção Concentrada; Habilidade com Atividades Manuais; Bom Relacionamento Interpessoal.

O que oferecemos como companhia

Na Bridgestone, o que realmente importa é gerar oportunidades de cocriação, ao mesmo tempo que estimulamos a sua curiosidade e criatividade para tornar a mobilidade mais segura, mais eficiente e mais sustentável para as gerações presentes e futuras.

  • Atividades de responsabilidade social corporativa;
  • Um ambiente de trabalho verdadeiramente global, dinâmico e desafiador;
  • Agilidade e eficácia no trabalho/vida e no seu bem-estar a longo prazo;
  • Uma equipe diversificada e inclusiva.

A Bridgestone orgulha-se de ser um empregador com oportunidades iguais de emprego. É nossa política considerar todas as pessoas, independentemente de idade, cor, origem, deficiência física ou mental, raça, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade e/ou expressão de gênero, informação genética ou qualquer outra característica protegida por leis federais, leis estaduais ou locais.

Bridgestone Americas, Inc. (BSAM), com sede em Nashville, Tennessee, e a Bridgestone Europa, Oriente Médio e África (BSEMEA), com sede em Bruxelas, Bélgica, operam coletivamente como uma região estratégica “Bridgestone West”. Na Bridgestone, você é sempre livre para ser.

title: Social Media Marketing Specialist | Remote | Us B2B Saas Startup In Real Estate Ops
description:
We connect talented tech professionals in Latin America and Canada with remote career opportunities at innovative startups worldwide. We specialize in finding roles that align with your skills, experience, and career goals. Our personalized approach ensures you're matched with companies that value your contributions and offer opportunities for growth. Whether you're a software engineer, designer, marketer, or other tech professional, we're here to help you take the next step in your career.

Company Overview

Our client is a profitable SaaS company that has supported property managers for over a decade. With more than 20,000 active users and 100M+ inspection photos processed, the platform helps customers—from single landlords to large firms—save time and reduce stress with mobile inspections, automated reports, and AI‑powered tools. The team of ~20 people is fully distributed and focused on steady growth and long‑term value.

Your Role

You’ll plan, create, and publish content that shows what property managers deal with daily—and how the product solves those exact problems. Most work centers on short videos, walkthroughs, carousels, and posts for Meta, LinkedIn, YouTube, and email, using real examples from the field, support, product updates, and customer inputs.

You’ll :

  • Produce short videos, screen recordings, carousels, and posts that show when a feature matters and why
  • Use real inputs (customer stories, field photos, support themes, product updates) to create concrete examples
  • Adapt one idea into multiple formats across social, YouTube Shorts, email, and occasional blog posts
  • Write clear captions and short copy that connect real property‑management problems to the product
  • Maintain consistent visual style and messaging across channels
  • Review performance metrics (views, watch time, clicks, comments) and refine topics
  • Add each new asset to an internal library for reuse across teams

You Bring :

  • Ability to explain complex features simply and accurately
  • Experience creating short‑form digital content (video or social posts)
  • Comfort recording screen captures and doing basic video edits (cuts, captions)
  • Ability to follow a content plan and publish consistently each week
  • Curiosity to learn how property managers work and what problems they face
  • Good organization and ownership of your weekly tasks
  • Comfortable working most of your day within U.S. business hours

Bonus Points :

  • Experience making how‑to content, tutorials, or simple walkthroughs
  • Background in property management, real estate, operations, or fieldwork
  • Experience writing short marketing copy, email snippets, or simple explainers
  • Familiarity with Canva or Figma (or willingness to learn quickly)
  • Previous work in SaaS, B2B tools, or workflow products

What’s Offered :

  • Fully remote contractor role (~40 hrs / week)
  • 10–17 USD per hour (~$2,000–3,000 / month)
  • Paid time off, coordinated with campaign cycles
  • Lean, collaborative team with direct input to Marketing Director
  • Long‑term stability with a profitable, steadily growing SaaS company
  • Opportunity to expand into channel ownership and campaign planning

Interview Process :

1️⃣ Online Tests – Short Wingfinder assessment and typing test

2️⃣ Screening Call – Conversation with the recruiter about your background and interest in the role

3️⃣ Marketing Challenge – Create a short social / video post and repurpose it into blog or email copy, based on real product inputs

4️⃣ Interview with Marketing Director – Deep dive on your content process, examples, and how you’d approach priorities

5️⃣ Final Interview with CEO – Discussion about company fit, expectations, and long‑term collaboration

Most candidates move through the process in about 1–2 weeks .

Fortune favors the bold. Join us.

Learn more atnerdy.com .

title: Enfermeiro - Centro Cirúrgico Salvador - BA
description:
Há 86 anos, a Fundação José Silveira mantém o olhar voltado para o futuro, reinventando suas práticas em um mundo imprevisível, sem perder de vista suas raízes sólidas naquilo que é a origem do propósito: cuidar da saúde e melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas.

Com isso, buscamos pessoas conectadas ao novo que venham contribuir com o constante crescimento e a perpetuação do nosso legado.

Junte-se ao nosso propósito!

  • Auxiliar no preparo da sala cirúrgica/obstétrico, segundo cada caso específico, no provimento dos materiais necessários à realização de cada ato cirúrgico, conforme programação informada;
  • Receber o paciente, conferir pulseira de identificação conforme protocolo de cirurgia e parto seguro e certificar-se de que está devidamente preparado, encaminhá-lo para a sala e auxiliar no transporte da maca para a mesa cirúrgica/obstétrica e vice-versa;
  • Auxiliar na realização dos procedimentos pré-cirúrgico /obstétrico e anestésicos, posicionando o paciente e fornecendo os materiais necessários no decorrer de sua realização;
  • Prestar assistência de enfermagem ao paciente durante a sua permanência no Centro, tendo em vista o seu bem-estar físico e psíquico, e auxiliar no seu encaminhamento ao setor de destino, após liberação do médico;
  • Executar as solicitações médicas e da Enfermeira, segundo orientações específicas e definidas;
  • Realizar controle de materiais esterilizados disponíveis para a realização de procedimentos, verificando sempre a data de validade, conforme rotina específica do setor;
  • Conferir o instrumental utilizado após cada ato cirúrgico/obstétrico e acondicioná-lo para fins de remessa para lavagem e esterilização;
  • Preencher as notas de sala segundo procedimentos definidos, tendo em vista a correta apropriação dos materiais utilizados e a confiabilidade na emissão da conta hospitalar correspondente;
  • Registrar os procedimentos realizados no prontuário, conforme procedimentos definidos, tendo em vista disponibilizar as informações necessárias para a continuidade do trabalho.
  • Manusear sistema PEP com prontuário eletrônico.
  • Curso Superior em enfermagem concluído;
  • Registro Coren BA ativo e regularizado;
  • Experiência na área de enfermagem com atuação em centro cirúrgico;
  • Disponibilidade para plantões

Os benefícios que você terá com a FJS:

  • Plano de saúde
  • Programa de saúde do colaborador

Criada em 21 de fevereiro de 1937 pelo Professor José Silveira, a Fundação José Silveira (FJS) vem ampliando sua obra em um processo de crescimento sustentável, firmado no planejamento estratégico e foco nos melhores resultados. Instituição filantrópica sem fins lucrativos, a Fundação José Silveira atende principalmente a população mais desassistida, com qualidade nos serviços prestados.

É o que demonstra o trabalho de referência das nossas unidades em áreas como combate à tuberculose, assistência neonatal, parto humanizado, tratamento do câncer de mama e reabilitação de pacientes com deficiências neuropsicomotoras, intelectuais e autismo. Por ano, são mais de 1,2 milhão de atendimentos realizados. A FJS promove, ainda, ações de prevenção e promoção da saúde e socioambientais voltadas às comunidades de Salvador e de municípios do interior da Bahia, contribuindo para a melhoria dos indicadores sociais e de saúde no estado.

title: Vice President Of Sales
description:
About GTTGTT is a leading networking and security as a service provider for multinational organizations, simply and securely connecting people and machines to data and applications – anywhere in the world.

We serve thousands of organizations, bringing together the right people, partners and technology to reduce the burden on IT teams and solve the most pressing networking and security challenges.

Built on our top-ranked global Tier 1 network, GTT Envision is a single global technology platform to connect, orchestrate, virtualize and automate enterprise networks, enabling customers with consumable solutions to achieve business missions and meet ongoing demand when, where and how needed.

Our portfolio includes SASE, SD-WAN, security, internet, voice and other connectivity options, complemented by a suite of professional services and exceptional sales and support teams in local markets around the globe.

We partner with our customers to deliver Greater Technology Together.

Summary

The VP, Sales - LATAM drives strategic market expansion for GTT by developing and nurturing high-value, long-term relationships with key Carrier, Wholesale, and Strategic Alliance partners across the Latin American region.

This role focuses on ecosystem development, identifying and securing new business models, and creating sustainable revenue channels through partnerships, rather than direct transactional sales.

The Manager will be responsible for defining and executing the strategic plan to significantly increase GTT's market presence and network reach in LATAM.

Job Scope and Stakeholder Engagement

This role serves as a strategic bridge between GTT's offerings and the LATAM carrier market.

External Focus : Primary interaction is with executive and strategic planning teams at Target Carrier Partners, Global Data Center Providers, and potential Channel Partners to establish commercial, network, and technology alliances.

Internal Collaboration : Works closely with Product, Strategy, Finance, and Legal to define partnership terms and new commercial models.

Acts as the voice of the LATAM market to inform Sales Engineering and Network Planning on necessary infrastructure investments.

Duties And Responsibilities

This role's success is measured by strategic outcomes and long-term pipeline growth, not immediate sales quota achievement.

Market Strategy & Penetration : Develop and execute a comprehensive LATAM Carrier Business Development plan, identifying white-space opportunities, competitive threats, and potential strategic partners to secure GTT's long-term competitive advantage.

Partnership Identification and Structuring : Proactively identify, qualify, and negotiate strategic agreements with major LATAM carriers (e.g., IXPs, Mobile Operators, Regional Tier 1 / 2 Carriers) to expand GTT's network footprint and service portfolio in the region.

Ecosystem Development : Cultivate a robust network of strategic channel and alliance partners to drive scalable, indirect distribution of GTT services.

Long-Term Pipeline Generation : Establish a pipeline focused on multi-year revenue potential stemming from new partnerships, joint ventures, and wholesale capacity swaps, ensuring sustainable growth.

Cultural and Business Acumen : Leverage deep regional knowledge and fluency in local business practices to effectively structure and manage relationships across diverse LATAM territories.

Reporting : Track and report on market penetration, new partnership launches, pipeline value of strategic deals, and the successful commercialization of new routes / services.

Required Experience / Qualifications

15+ years of experience in a Business Development, Partnership Management, or Strategic Alliance role within the global telecommunications / technology sector focusing on the LATAM carrier market.

Demonstrated Success in Ecosystem Building : A proven track record of successfully identifying, negotiating, and launching complex, non-standard commercial agreements (e.g., wholesale capacity swaps, joint GTM strategies, network peering).

Deep Regional Carrier Knowledge : Thorough understanding of the competitive landscape, regulatory environment, key contacts, and market trends across major LATAM countries.

Strategic & Financial Acumen : Knowledge of business concepts and financial modeling needed to assess partnership viability, structure favorable deals, and articulate the long-term return on investment (ROI).

Exceptional Communication & Negotiation : Superior ability to influence, communicate, and negotiate with executive-level stakeholders both internally and with external carrier partners.

Bilingual Proficiency : Fluency in Spanish and English is essential.

Portuguese is a significant advantage, to effectively navigate business and cultural nuances in the region.

Networking and Relationship Capital : Existing strong relationships and a robust network within the executive and planning ranks of LATAM carrier accounts.

Ambition and Strategic Thinking : A proactive mindset focused on identifying and securing next-generation opportunities and expanding GTT's strategic positioning, not just fulfilling immediate demand.

Core Competencies

Business Acumen : Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations.

Effective Communications : Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Negotiating : Knowledge of successful negotiation concepts and techniques; ability to negotiate successfully across the organization and with external vendors and clients in a constructive and collaborative manner.

Problem Solving : Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Networking : Understanding of the business value of creating mutually beneficial relationships with individuals outside of incumbent's own organization and ability to generate productive relationships with internal and external partners that improve access to resources and expertise.

Channel Sales : Knowledge of various channel sales strategies and solutions used to execute and fulfil a sales plan; ability to sell a hospitality organization's brand, products, and services through multiple and diverse avenues.

Sales Proposals and Presentations : Knowledge of sales processes, tools, and techniques; ability to prepare and present formal recommendations for how the organization can meet the customer's needs.

Value Selling : Knowledge of the principles and practices for selling products, technology and services; ability to provide overall product / service 'value' and to differentiate support offerings that address clearly understood customer needs.

Universal Competencies : Continuous Improvement : Knowledge of transformation initiatives to drive fundamental changes, enhance responsiveness and efficiency to core business practices.

Ability to drive cultural changes from best effort to results oriented.

Customer First (Customer Facing) : Knowledge of internal customer interactions, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, and partnership.

Ability to build an environment supporting internal customer value creation at every level.

Operational Excellence : Understanding the system-driven processes for consistency and scalability.

Ability to re-focus processes and systems from integration activity to maximizing a positive customer impact and anticipating future trends.
